suppress.notes:
IBM MQ 8.0.0.0 through 8.0.0.10, 9.0.0.0 through 9.0.0.5, and 9.1.0.0 through 9.1.1 is vulnerable to a denial of service attack within the TLS key renegotiation function. IBM X-Force ID: 156564. IBM MQ 8.0.0.4 - 8.0.0.12, 9.0.0.0 - 9.0.0.6, 9.1.0.0 - 9.1.0.2, and 9.1.0 - 9.1.2 AMQP Listeners could allow an unauthorized user to conduct a session fixation attack due to clients not being disconnected as they should. IBM X-Force ID: 159352. IBM WebSphere MQ V7.1, 7.5, IBM MQ V8, IBM MQ V9.0LTS, IBM MQ V9.1 LTS, and IBM MQ V9.1 CD are vulnerable to a denial of service attack caused by specially crafted messages. IBM X-Force ID: 160013. IBM MQ 7.5.0.0 - 7.5.0.9, 7.1.0.0 - 7.1.0.9, 8.0.0.0 - 8.0.0.12, 9.0.0.0 - 9.0.0.6, 9.1.0.0 - 9.1.0.2, and 9.1.0 - 9.1.2 command server is vulnerable to a denial of service attack caused by an authenticated and authorized user using specially crafted PCF messages. IBM X-Force ID: 162084. IBM MQ and IBM MQ Appliance 8.0 and 9.0 LTS could allow a remote attacker with intimate knowledge of the server to cause a denial of service when receiving data on the channel. IBM X-Force ID: 166629. IBM MQ and IBM MQ Appliance 8.0 and 9.0 LTS client connecting to a Queue Manager could cause a SIGSEGV denial of service caused by converting an invalid message. IBM X-Force ID: 168639. IBM MQ and IBM MQ Appliance 7.1, 7.5, 8.0, 9.0 LTS, 9.1 LTS, and 9.1 CD could allow a local attacker to obtain sensitive information by inclusion of sensitive data within trace. IBM X-Force ID: 168862. IBM MQ and IBM MQ Appliance 7.1, 7.5, 8.0, 9.0 LTS, 9.1 LTS, and 9.1 CD is vulnerable to a denial of service attack that would allow an authenticated user to crash the queue and require a restart due to an error processing error messages. IBM X-Force ID: 170967. IBM MQ and IBM MQ Appliance 7.1, 7.5, 8.0, 9.0 LTS, 9.1 LTS, and 9.1 CD could allow a local attacker to obtain sensitive information by inclusion of sensitive data within runmqras data. IBM MQ and MQ Appliance 8.0, 9.1 LTS, and 9.1 CD could allow an authenticated user cause a denial of service due to a memory leak. IBM X-Force ID: 175840.
Since the jar is optional; this is supplied by the user. so we don't physically care about the CVE for build purposes.

file name: json-20201115.jar CVE-2022-45688 in org.json/json - misleading CPE The cpe on the NIST site: cpe:2.3:a:hutool:hutool:5.8.10:*:*:*:*:*:*:* does not seem related to org.json/json https://github.com/jeremylong/DependencyCheck/issues/5401 users can already have some control by setting the -Xss JVM option

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.

com.ibm.mq.allclient 9.4.5.1 is the newest published 9.x CD client: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/ibm/mq/com.ibm.mq.allclient/maven-metadata.xml CVE-2026-10751 affects Java messaging in 9.4.0.0 through 9.4.5.1 CD. No non-downgrading 9.x minor/patch release is available; newer CD clients are 10.x, outside the permitted major version. Authenticated client-side arbitrary code execution remains an accepted risk, not a remediated vulnerability. https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7284898
The remaining product-wide CPE matches affect components not contained in this Java client: Server: CVE-2026-10027, CVE-2026-10575, CVE-2026-10853, CVE-2026-11375, CVE-2026-11376, CVE-2026-11378 and CVE-2026-18142. https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7284893 https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7287778 https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7284905 https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7284948 https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7294498 https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7284945 https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7294663 .NET messaging: CVE-2026-10859, affected CD versions 9.4.0.0 through 9.4.5.1. https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7294664 Managed File Transfer: CVE-2026-11724, affected CD versions 9.4.0.0 through 9.4.5.1. https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7294503 Native standard client: CVE-2026-14511, affected versions 9.4.5.0 through 9.4.5.1. https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/7290859 These exclusions apply only to this exact Java artifact, not to an MQ server/client deployment.
